text: {"name":"usb_wlan_recv_fc_open","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Opens USB WLAN receive flow control by programming mode-dependent MMIO bits and copying the supplied configuration, returning an error if the operation is busy or aborted.","subsystem":"hal","var_renames":{"v3":"recv_fc_state","v4":"mode_flag","v5":"mmio_regs","v6":"copy_status"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":2864,"meaning":"MMIO control register masked with 0xE007FFFF when the mode flag is set."},{"offset":2048,"meaning":"MMIO control register with bit 13 set when the mode flag is set."},{"offset":2852,"meaning":"MMIO control register with bit 0 set when the mode flag is clear."}]}
